newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE, EYES ON GERMANY, NEED TO BEAT ARMENIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE, EYES ON GERMANY, NEED TO BEAT ARMENIA.

text.p: Ukraine, who lead their World Cup qualifying group ahead of hot favourites Germany, are not underestimating a skilful Armenian team who travel Kiev on Wednesday with nothing to lose.
Ukraine's head coach Jozhef Sabo has no intention of experimenting for the European group nine match.
A Ukrainian team spokesman said on Tuesday that Sabo would field a side unchanged from the one who gave a determined display before going down 2-0 to Germany in Breman last week.
"Without a doubt we have to have the three points against Armenia on our home turf," said Sabo. "We don't want to underestimate our opponents."
Despite losing in Germany, the Ukrainians are a point ahead of the European champions, who have a game in hand. Third-placed Portugal are three points off the lead.
Armenia, with four points from five games, are out of the running after a scoreless draw with Northern Ireland in Yerevan last week.

With Germany paying a return visit to the Republic Stadium in Kiev on June 7, Ukraine need to beat their former Soviet countrymen to maintain a realistic chance of knocking the mighty Germans off the road to France '98.

Ukraine - Oleksandr Shovkovsky; Oleg Luzhny, Serhiy Bezhenar, Oleksandr Golovko; Viktor Skrypnyk, Serhiy Nagornyak, Yuri Maksimov, Yuri Kalitvintsev, Vitaly Kosovsky; Andriy Shevchenko, Serhiy Rebrov.

Armenia - Roman Berezovsky; Yervand Sykiasyan, Bardan Khachatryan, Sarkis Ovsepyan, Michel Ter-Zakarian; Aramais Episkoposyan, Artur Petrosyan, Garnik Avalyan, Karapet Mikaelyan; Hamlet Mkhitaryan, Eric Assadourian.
